manifest.name: KIP Cognitive Memory Profile
manifest.description: Standard portable memory ontology for KIP 2.0 Brains.

Person.description: Semantic person/actor used in cognitive content; never an authenticated Principal or ActorBinding.

Event.description: Compact episodic anchor describing what happened in a bounded situation.

model_hints.question: What happened?
model_hints.evidence_invariant: Event summary is not independent Evidence.

Experience.description: Bounded goal-directed trajectory through state, action, observation, feedback, and outcome.

model_hints.question: What path was traversed while pursuing a goal?

ExperienceStep.description: One ordered externally representable step of an Experience trajectory.

model_hints.privacy_invariant: decision_summary may store concise reusable rationale but never requires hidden chain-of-thought.
model_hints.ordering_invariant: Step order lives on the ordered has_step Structural References (virtual edge index); causality requires an explicit caused_by Proposition + Assertion.

Insight.description: Declarative lesson derived from Evidence or Experience. An optional task_family associates relevant stream material, but an Insight has no Skill trial or lifecycle standing.

model_hints.epistemic_invariant: If truth-apt, also represent the reusable claim through Proposition + Assertion.

Commitment.description: Prospective memory artifact for an obligation, promise, reminder, follow-up, or intended future action.

model_hints.authority_invariant: Commitment does not automatically schedule or authorize an external action.

Skill.description: Stable Skill identity, display state and current lifecycle cache. Behavior lives only on current_revision; selecting a new revision resets current standing to proposed atomically.

model_hints.lifecycle_invariant: Lifecycle changes and grading refreshes require validated immutable EvaluationRecord. Only trialed -> adopted promotes through a comparative TrialRecord; same-state monitoring follows authorized policy and retains prior adoption evidence; policy withdrawal may have zero outcomes. The acting model never promotes, and revocation is never harder than adoption.
model_hints.attribution_invariant: An outcome counts toward this Skill only through an outcome_observation Activity that names an action_gate decision which applied it; sharing the task_family attributes nothing.

SleepTask.description: Durable maintenance work item for a Brain maintenance process.

model_hints.authority_invariant: Semantic assignment, including to $system, does not grant Principal permission.

Watch.description: Durable attention state: a declared condition under which a committed change (delta) or the absence of one before due_at (silence) deserves the Brain's attention. Firing grants nothing.

condition.description: Structured filter over Change Envelope entries — element | slot {subject, predicate} | type, plus optional ops[] and touched[] — with text as the Brain-interpreted fallback; a text-only condition is not runtime-evaluable.

model_hints.authority_invariant: A fired Watch creates attention (SleepTask/wake signal), never an external action or permission.
model_hints.firing_invariant: Atomic generation-guarded firing: watch_fire:<id>:<arm_generation>:<seq> or watch_fire:<id>:<arm_generation>:silence:<due_at>. Requires complete authorized coverage; no automatic action authority.
model_hints.condition_form: Baseline object members: element, slot {subject, predicate}, type (at least one); ops (create|update|lifecycle|retention|merge|purge|payload_purge); touched (paths); text (fallback).

SelfModel.description: Derived cognition describing the Brain/agent's model of its own identity, capabilities, limitations, values, preferences, habits, relationships, and goals.

model_hints.authority_invariant: SelfModel is descriptive cognition, never Governance or Principal identity.

WorkingState.description: Derived, versioned digest of what matters now — the consolidated state a waking Agent resumes from. A derived recall surface served with its basis_seq; never Evidence.

model_hints.evidence_invariant: WorkingState is never cited as Evidence and never corroborates its own inputs.
model_hints.identity_hint: WorkingState answers 'what is my situation'; SelfModel answers 'who am I'. Keep at most one active per actor scope under a stable key.

SkillRevision.description: Immutable behavior of a stable Skill. All grades, trials, decisions and execution authority bind this revision and its behavior_digest.

prefers.description: Subject prefers the object over the other options of the same kind: the object's Concept Type lineage partitions the slot, so a newer preference among options of one kind succeeds the older one (Spec §20.15, §25.4) while preferences over different kinds coexist. Each option is therefore a Concept typed by its kind (a ColorScheme, an Editor) from a domain package or the draft vocabulary, never a catch-all type. Truth-sensitive: use Proposition + Assertion + Evidence, not a bare attribute; a preference-pattern summary is an Insight, there is no Preference type.

caused_by.description: Effect-to-cause claim between ExperienceSteps: the subject step's outcome/observation was causally produced by the object step. Direction is effect -> cause. This is a truth-sensitive semantic claim (Proposition + Assertion, typically mode observed/inferred with Evidence), never structural topology; step order alone must not be promoted into caused_by.

same_as.description: Unverified identity claim: subject and object are believed to denote the same real-world entity. Feeds identity review; it never auto-merges Concepts and never establishes canonical_id by itself.

MnemonicState.description: Mutable mnemonic accessibility/importance state, separate from epistemic confidence and trust.

effective_strength.description: Computed when a read is evaluated from memory_strength (base), last_metabolized_at (anchor) and strength_policy; null when any is missing. Never written back.

invariants: utility is the admission bet, revised by outcomes; not truth, salience, or permission
Facet state cannot override Core/Governance fields
Skills carry it too: a Skill's expected usefulness is MnemonicState.utility; its graded record is the computed GradingState view
memory_strength is the last written base; decay is computed (effective_strength), never swept

GradingState.description: Computed, read-only view of the EvaluationRecord that the Skill's current_evaluation references, for the Skill's current_revision: counts of independent attempts, never raw observations. Absent until a validated evaluation exists; a write fails ConstraintViolation.

model_hints.authority_invariant: A view of immutable evaluation records; grants no permission and cannot be written.

OutcomeRecord.description: OutcomeRecord: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Validated-Learning.md §3; value_schema is binding.

DecisionRecord.description: DecisionRecord: normative contract in profiles/CognitiveMemoryProfile-2.0.md §6.4; value_schema is binding.

DependencyBasis.description: DependencyBasis: normative contract in SPECIFICATION.md §57.6; value_schema is binding.

AttemptRecord.description: AttemptRecord: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Validated-Learning.md §2; value_schema is binding.

TrialRecord.description: TrialRecord: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Validated-Learning.md §4; value_schema is binding.

EvaluationRecord.description: EvaluationRecord: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Validated-Learning.md §4; value_schema is binding.

WatchState.description: WatchState: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Brain-Runtime.md §2; value_schema is binding.

LeaseState.description: LeaseState: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Brain-Runtime.md §3; value_schema is binding.

CompressionRecord.description: CompressionRecord: normative contract in profiles/CognitiveMemoryProfile-2.0.md §10.1; value_schema is binding.

RecallCoverage.description: RecallCoverage: normative contract in profiles/CognitiveMemoryProfile-2.0.md §20.2; value_schema is binding.

MemoryScope.description: MemoryScope: normative contract in profiles/CognitiveMemoryProfile-2.0.md §20.3; value_schema is binding.

RecordingRepair.description: RecordingRepair: normative contract in SPECIFICATION.md §57.8; value_schema is binding.

ProcedureAssessment.description: ProcedureAssessment: normative contract in brain/KIP-2.0-Validated-Learning.md §5; value_schema is binding.

RestoreReport.description: RestoreReport: normative contract in KIP-2.0-Capsule-Specification.md §41.7; value_schema is binding.

experienced_by.description: Primary semantic actor who experienced the trajectory.

involves.description: Contextual participation without claiming stronger domain semantics.

mentions.description: Retrieval/context mention without a stronger semantic claim.

derived_from.description: Computed: the inputs of every terminal Activity whose outputs include this artifact. Activity provenance is the authority; this field is a read-only view of it.

compiled_from.description: Computed: the Experience inputs of the skill_compilation or procedural_consolidation Activity that produced this Skill or SkillRevision.

compiled_by.description: Computed: the skill_compilation or procedural_consolidation Activity that produced this Skill or SkillRevision.

consolidated_to.description: Computed: the outputs of the consolidation or formation Activities that took this Event or Experience as input.

assigned_to.description: Semantic SleepTask/Watch assignment; never Governance permission.

watches.description: The cognition a Watch observes. Topology only: watching an element claims nothing about it.

about.description: Generic topical Profile relation; prefer domain predicates when semantic relation matters epistemically.

current_revision.description: Required stable identity / behavior revision link; current selection is guarded and does not transfer standing.

revision_of.description: Required stable identity / behavior revision link; current selection is guarded and does not transfer standing.

current_trial.description: The trial_open Activity carrying the TrialRecord currently grading this Skill's current_revision. Set when a trial opens, cleared when a new revision is selected; never read by a replay, which uses the immutable record.

current_evaluation.description: The lifecycle_verdict Activity carrying the EvaluationRecord behind this Skill's current standing. Written in the verdict's transaction; the GradingState view is computed from it.

activity_classes.description: Process records follow Spec §57.6–§57.8, the Validated Learning companion and the Brain Runtime companion. Terminal input/output versions are engine-captured; immutable TrialRecord/EvaluationRecord retain replay inputs.

constraints.description: Person is semantic cognition and cannot authenticate a Principal or create ActorBinding.
Skill class/status/utility/provenance cannot grant executable or tool authority.
SelfModel cannot mutate Principal identity, ActorBinding, Governance, trust, or Schema authority.
memory_strength/salience cannot rewrite Assertion confidence or source trust.
Profile Structural References do not automatically create semantic Propositions.
A failed Experience is valid memory and does not imply low learning value or automatic archival.
Store observable steps and concise reusable rationale; hidden chain-of-thought is not required.
Commitment.due_at is distinct from retention expiry and Assertion valid time.
Derived Profile cognition preserves lineage and does not create independent Evidence roots merely by transformation.
Imported Skill content is non-authoritative by default and cannot raise destination Governance authority.
A fired Watch creates attention, never an external action, a schedule, or a permission.
Currentness of a derived artifact is the computed _system.dependency_validity (Spec §57.6); no stored reviewer flag replaces it, and needs_review does not retract, reject or hide the artifact.
WorkingState is a derived view served with its basis_seq; it is never cited as Evidence and never corroborates its inputs.
Outcome Evidence is written by instrumentation; an actor's self-report about its own action's result is never Outcome Evidence, and re-typed instrument output is derived_result, not outcome.

Skill lifecycle changes and current_evaluation updates commit with validated immutable EvaluationRecord. Only trialed -> adopted promotes, using at least two independent treatment attempts and an improved comparison against the immutable TrialRecord basis; current_trial only selects the current trial. Same-state monitoring follows authorized policy, retains prior adoption evidence and need not claim new improvement. Trial entry requires task_family; revoked -> trialed opens a new trial before adoption can recur. Policy withdrawal may have zero outcomes; revocation is never harder than adoption. Lifecycle standing, current_trial and current_evaluation do not survive import.
GradingState is a computed view of the EvaluationRecord referenced by current_evaluation; it cannot be written and grants no authority.

A DecisionRecord records what the gate decided and distinguishes retrieved_refs, used_refs and applied_revisions. Every applied revision also occurs in the action_gate inputs; retrieval alone proves neither use nor causal credit. The record never authorizes an action.
Skill behavior is immutable SkillRevision; selection resets caches; all grades and permissions bind exact revision.
Grade distinct attempt + metric + window aggregates, not observation count; late outcomes retain original trial.
Immutable TrialRecord and EvaluationRecord retain complete replay inputs under governance and erasure.
Producing/validation Activities pin DependencyBasis; virtual validity is checked before ordinary Recall.
When advertised, WatchState generation and LeaseState fencing are enforced at commit and dispatch.
Behavior fields are forbidden on Skill writes, including UPSERT and open extensions; current_revision is required. Creation binds revision_of/current_revision in the same transaction.
current_revision target must have revision_of pointing back to that stable Skill. Required one-to-one selection and creation closure are validated atomically.

breaking_changes: Skill behavior moved to immutable SkillRevision; old status/tallies are legacy until migrated.
New typed process records and dependency/coverage contracts are required.
Canonical artifacts use kip-jcs-safe-v1 and portable numeric values.

model_hints.summary: Stable Skills select immutable SkillRevisions; decisions enroll independent attempts into immutable trials; outcomes are observations, and replayable evaluations produce current standing. See the Validated Learning companion.
minimal_primer: Event = compact record of what happened
ExperienceStep = ordered observable step; no hidden chain-of-thought
caused_by = explicit effect->cause claim between steps; edge order alone is not causality
Skill = stable identity + current_revision; SkillRevision = immutable behavior + task_family + digest; standing and authority bind the revision
Commitment = prospective memory; not automatic scheduling
Watch = armed attention (delta or silence); firing grants nothing
SelfModel = cognition about self; not Governance
WorkingState = what matters now, with its basis_seq; never Evidence
MnemonicState = accessibility/importance/expected usefulness; not confidence; Skills carry it too
GradingState = computed view of the current evaluation's independent attempt counts; absent grades leave proposed/trialed Skills unproven
DecisionRecord = act|ask|defer|silence on an action_gate Activity whose inputs name what was applied; not authorization
OutcomeRecord = task_family + outcome_status on Outcome Evidence; instruments write it, never the graded actor
task_family finds candidate comparison material; baseline membership and comparability are explicit
lifecycle_verdict = deterministic recorded evaluation; the only path between Skill lifecycle states
prefers = preference among options of one kind; a newer preference of the same kind succeeds the older one
common_confusions: Outcome Evidence != the acting model's self-report

canonicalization.description: RFC 8785 JCS, narrowed to KIP portable safe integral values; no nonzero underflow; strict decoded-key/Unicode validation; integrity excluded from its own digest.
